comments: It sounds reasonable, I am supportive of this proposal. Let's discuss it at API Review meeting.

I've applied "help wanted" label, which means that we would be more than happy to review a community PR that adds these two new methods.


Some hints:
- before you start working on the issue, please leave a comment here so there is only one person working on it
- the new methods needs to be added to a `ref` assembly in their approved form [here](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/655b177da2e423a04a60a331bc6c11fe5ec427c3/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Abstractions/ref/Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Abstractions.cs#L60-L72)
- the implementation needs to be added [here](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Abstractions/src/MemoryCacheExtensions.cs)
- the tests should be added [here](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/tree/main/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory/tests)
- once you build the whole repo by following the steps described in [here](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/tree/main/docs/workflow/building/libraries#building-everything), you can rebuild only specific parts of it when re-running the tests:

```cmd
.\dotnet.cmd build .\src\libraries\Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Abstractions\Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Abstractions.sln
&& .\dotnet.cmd build .\src\libraries\Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory\tests\Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory.Tests.csproj /t:Test
```

review_comments: Can we now refactor the existing `GetOrCreate[Async]` to call these new methods?
Sure, make sense, thanks very much, updated
If `GetOrCreateAsync` is called again while `await factory(entry)` is still in progress, this method will return `null`. I think the await needs to be moved above `CreateEntry` to avoid this

Right, the `entry` is "committed" to the cache until it gets disposed.  If called twice, it can return the value of the thread 1 if it finished before thread 2 called `cache.TryGetValue` or it can return the value of thread 2's `factory` if `cache.TryGetValue` returned false on thread 2.  It should never return null.
